```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(gt)
library(patchwork)
library(systemfonts) 
library(knitr)

base_colors <- c(
  "#0173B2", "#DE8F05", "#029E73", "#CC78BC",
  "#CA9161", "#949494", "#ECE133", "#56B4E9"
)

base_theme <- function(base_size = 10, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size, color = "gray30", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold", color = "black")
    )
}

theme_set(base_theme())

scale_colour_discrete <- function(...) scale_colour_manual(values = base_colors, ...)
scale_fill_discrete <- function(...) scale_fill_manual(values = base_colors, ...)

dat_reg <- read_csv("data/updated_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(
    quartile = factor(quartile, levels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")),
    OA = factor(OA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Not OA", "OA")),
    fund = factor(fund, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Not funded", "Funded")),
    coop = factor(coop, levels = c("bilateral", "multilateral", "hyperauthored"), 
                  labels = c("Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyper-authored")),
    dominance = factor(dominance, levels = c("vn", "Balanced", "jp", "o"),
                       labels = c("VN-dominated", "Balanced", "JP-dominated", "Other")),
    fa = factor(fa, levels = c("vn", "jp", "o"), 
                labels = c("VN-led", "JP-led", "Other-led")),
    corr_type = factor(corr_type, levels = c("Vietnam", "Japan", "Both", "Other"))
  )

dat_core <- dat_reg |> filter(coop != "Hyper-authored")
```


```{r}
# Citation distribution
summary(dat_reg$cited)

# Zero inflation
table(dat_reg$cited == 0)
mean(dat_reg$cited == 0)

# Dispersion
mean_citations <- mean(dat_reg$cited, na.rm = TRUE)
var_citations <- var(dat_reg$cited, na.rm = TRUE)
dispersion_ratio <- var_citations / mean_citations

mean_citations
var_citations
dispersion_ratio
```


```{r}
library(pscl)
library(MASS)

# Fit candidate models
m_poisson <- glm(cited ~ year + fa + fund, 
                 data = dat_reg, family = poisson)

m_nb <- glm.nb(cited ~ year + fa + fund, 
               data = dat_reg)

m_zip <- zeroinfl(cited ~ year + fa + fund | year + fa, 
                  data = dat_reg, dist = "poisson")

m_zinb <- zeroinfl(cited ~ year + fa + fund | year + fa, 
                   data = dat_reg, dist = "negbin")

# Compare models
AIC(m_poisson, m_nb, m_zip, m_zinb)
BIC(m_poisson, m_nb, m_zip, m_zinb)

# Vuong test (ZIP vs Poisson, ZINB vs NB)
vuong(m_zip, m_poisson)
vuong(m_zinb, m_nb)

# Overdispersion test
library(AER)
dispersiontest(m_poisson)
```


```{r}
dat_analysis <- dat_core

nrow(dat_analysis)
sum(complete.cases(dat_analysis[, c("cited", "year", "coop")]))
sum(complete.cases(dat_analysis[, c("cited", "year", "coop", "fa", "dominance", "corr_type", "prop_vn_authors", "is_corr_same_fa")]))
sum(complete.cases(dat_analysis[, c("cited", "year", "coop", "fa", "dominance", "corr_type", "prop_vn_authors", "is_corr_same_fa", "fund", "bilateral_funding", "n_sectors")]))
sum(complete.cases(dat_analysis[, c("cited", "year", "coop", "fa", "dominance", "corr_type", "prop_vn_authors", "is_corr_same_fa", "fund", "bilateral_funding", "n_sectors", "sjr_score", "quartile", "OA")]))

dat_complete <- dat_analysis %>%
  filter(complete.cases(cited, year, coop, fa, dominance, corr_type, prop_vn_authors, is_corr_same_fa, fund, bilateral_funding, n_sectors, sjr_score, quartile, OA, LS, SS, PS, HS, engi, medi, comp, env))

nrow(dat_complete)

m1 <- glm.nb(cited ~ year, data = dat_complete)
m2 <- glm.nb(cited ~ year + coop, data = dat_complete)
m3 <- glm.nb(cited ~ year + coop + fa + dominance + corr_type + prop_vn_authors + is_corr_same_fa, data = dat_complete)
m4 <- glm.nb(cited ~ year + coop + fa + dominance + corr_type + prop_vn_authors + is_corr_same_fa + fund + bilateral_funding + n_sectors, data = dat_complete)
m5 <- glm.nb(cited ~ year + coop + fa + dominance + corr_type + prop_vn_authors + is_corr_same_fa + fund + bilateral_funding + n_sectors + sjr_score + quartile + OA, data = dat_complete)
m6 <- glm.nb(cited ~ year + coop + fa + dominance + corr_type + prop_vn_authors + is_corr_same_fa + fund + bilateral_funding + n_sectors + sjr_score + quartile + OA + LS + SS + PS + HS + engi + medi + comp + env, data = dat_complete)
m7 <- glm.nb(cited ~ year + coop + fa * year + dominance * year + corr_type + prop_vn_authors + is_corr_same_fa + fund + bilateral_funding + n_sectors + sjr_score + quartile + OA + LS + SS + PS + HS + engi + medi + comp + env, data = dat_complete)

data.frame(
  Model = paste0("M", 1:7),
  AIC = c(AIC(m1), AIC(m2), AIC(m3), AIC(m4), AIC(m5), AIC(m6), AIC(m7)),
  BIC = c(BIC(m1), BIC(m2), BIC(m3), BIC(m4), BIC(m5), BIC(m6), BIC(m7))
)

lrtest(m1, m2)
lrtest(m2, m3)
lrtest(m3, m4)
lrtest(m4, m5)
lrtest(m5, m6)
lrtest(m6, m7)
```

```{r}
table(dat_complete$fa)

  mutate(
    year_c = year - mean(year),
    fa = relevel(factor(fa), ref = "VN-led"),
    dominance = relevel(factor(dominance), ref = "VN-dominated")
  )

m7_refit <- glm.nb(cited ~ year_c + coop + fa * year_c + dominance * year_c + corr_type + prop_vn_authors + is_corr_same_fa + fund + bilateral_funding + n_sectors + sjr_score + quartile + OA + LS + SS + PS + HS + engi + medi + comp + env, data = dat_complete)

summary(m7_refit)
tidy(m7_refit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>% print(n = 34)
```


```{r}
dat_complete %>%
  group_by(fa) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_year = mean(year),
    mean_cited = mean(cited),
    median_cited = median(cited)
  )

dat_complete %>%
  group_by(dominance) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_year = mean(year),
    mean_cited = mean(cited),
    median_cited = median(cited)
  )

pred_years <- seq(2000, 2025, by = 5)
pred_data <- expand.grid(
  year_c = pred_years - mean(dat_complete$year),
  fa = c("VN-led", "JP-led", "Other-led"),
  coop = "Bilateral",
  dominance = "Balanced",
  corr_type = "Vietnam",
  prop_vn_authors = 0.5,
  is_corr_same_fa = 1,
  fund = "Funded",
  bilateral_funding = 1,
  n_sectors = 2,
  sjr_score = median(dat_complete$sjr_score, na.rm = TRUE),
  quartile = "Q1",
  OA = "OA",
  LS = 1, SS = 0, PS = 0, HS = 0,
  engi = 1, medi = 0, comp = 0, env = 0
)

pred_data$predicted <- predict(m7_refit, newdata = pred_data, type = "response")
pred_data$year <- pred_data$year_c + mean(dat_complete$year)

pred_data %>%
  dplyr::select(year, fa, predicted) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = fa, values_from = predicted)
```

```{r}
fig_fa_trends <- dat_complete %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2025) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    VN_led = mean(fa == "VN-led") * 100,
    JP_led = mean(fa == "JP-led") * 100,
    Other_led = mean(fa == "Other-led") * 100
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "First_Author", values_to = "Percentage") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = Percentage, color = First_Author)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, size = 1) +
  labs(title = "First Authorship Trends", y = "Percentage (%)", x = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

print(fig_fa_trends)

fig_dom_trends <- dat_complete %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2025) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    VN_dominated = mean(dominance == "VN-dominated") * 100,
    Balanced = mean(dominance == "Balanced") * 100,
    JP_dominated = mean(dominance == "JP-dominated") * 100
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "Dominance", values_to = "Percentage") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = Percentage, color = Dominance)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Authorship Dominance Trends", y = "Percentage (%)", x = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

print(fig_dom_trends)
```

```{r}
library(DescTools)

PseudoR2(m7_refit, which = "all")

data.frame(
  Model = paste0("M", 1:7),
  AIC = c(AIC(m1), AIC(m2), AIC(m3), AIC(m4), AIC(m5), AIC(m6), AIC(m7_refit)),
  BIC = c(BIC(m1), BIC(m2), BIC(m3), BIC(m4), BIC(m5), BIC(m6), BIC(m7_refit)),
  LogLik = c(logLik(m1), logLik(m2), logLik(m3), logLik(m4), logLik(m5), logLik(m6), logLik(m7_refit)),
  Deviance = c(deviance(m1), deviance(m2), deviance(m3), deviance(m4), deviance(m5), deviance(m6), deviance(m7_refit)),
  Df_residual = c(df.residual(m1), df.residual(m2), df.residual(m3), df.residual(m4), df.residual(m5), df.residual(m6), df.residual(m7_refit))
)

res_pearson <- residuals(m7_refit, type = "pearson")
res_deviance <- residuals(m7_refit, type = "deviance")

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(fitted(m7_refit), res_pearson, main = "Pearson Residuals vs Fitted", xlab = "Fitted", ylab = "Pearson Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "red")
plot(fitted(m7_refit), res_deviance, main = "Deviance Residuals vs Fitted", xlab = "Fitted", ylab = "Deviance Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "red")
hist(res_pearson, breaks = 50, main = "Histogram of Pearson Residuals")
qqnorm(res_pearson)
qqline(res_pearson, col = "red")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

m7_ols <- lm(log(cited + 1) ~ year_c + coop + fa * year_c + dominance * year_c + corr_type + prop_vn_authors + is_corr_same_fa + fund + bilateral_funding + n_sectors + sjr_score + quartile + OA + LS + SS + PS + HS + engi + medi + comp + env, data = dat_complete)

summary(m7_ols)$r.squared
summary(m7_ols)$adj.r.squared
AIC(m7_ols)
```

```{r}
tidy_m7 <- tidy(m7_refit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)

hypothesis_tests <- tribble(
  ~Hypothesis, ~Coefficient, ~IRR, ~CI_lower, ~CI_upper, ~p_value, ~Interpretation,
  
  "H3a: VN first authorship (vs VN at mean year 2019)", "faJP-led", 
  tidy_m7$estimate[tidy_m7$term == "faJP-led"],
  tidy_m7$conf.low[tidy_m7$term == "faJP-led"],
  tidy_m7$conf.high[tidy_m7$term == "faJP-led"],
  tidy_m7$p.value[tidy_m7$term == "faJP-led"],
  ifelse(tidy_m7$p.value[tidy_m7$term == "faJP-led"] > 0.05, "No significant difference",
         ifelse(tidy_m7$estimate[tidy_m7$term == "faJP-led"] < 0.95, "JP disadvantage", "JP advantage")),
  
  "H3a: Other first authorship (vs VN at mean year)", "faOther-led",
  tidy_m7$estimate[tidy_m7$term == "faOther-led"],
  tidy_m7$conf.low[tidy_m7$term == "faOther-led"],
  tidy_m7$conf.high[tidy_m7$term == "faOther-led"],
  tidy_m7$p.value[tidy_m7$term == "faOther-led"],
  "Other advantage persists",
  
  "H3b: JP correspondence (vs VN)", "corr_typeJapan",
  tidy_m7$estimate[tidy_m7$term == "corr_typeJapan"],
  tidy_m7$conf.low[tidy_m7$term == "corr_typeJapan"],
  tidy_m7$conf.high[tidy_m7$term == "corr_typeJapan"],
  tidy_m7$p.value[tidy_m7$term == "corr_typeJapan"],
  "Equity achieved - no difference",
  
  "H3c: Balanced dominance (vs VN-dominated)", "dominanceBalanced",
  tidy_m7$estimate[tidy_m7$term == "dominanceBalanced"],
  tidy_m7$conf.low[tidy_m7$term == "dominanceBalanced"],
  tidy_m7$conf.high[tidy_m7$term == "dominanceBalanced"],
  tidy_m7$p.value[tidy_m7$term == "dominanceBalanced"],
  "VN-dominated performs better",
  
  "H3c: JP-dominated (vs VN-dominated)", "dominanceJP-dominated",
  tidy_m7$estimate[tidy_m7$term == "dominanceJP-dominated"],
  tidy_m7$conf.low[tidy_m7$term == "dominanceJP-dominated"],
  tidy_m7$conf.high[tidy_m7$term == "dominanceJP-dominated"],
  tidy_m7$p.value[tidy_m7$term == "dominanceJP-dominated"],
  "VN-dominated performs better",
  
  "H3d: JP first authorship convergence", "year_c:faJP-led",
  tidy_m7$estimate[tidy_m7$term == "year_c:faJP-led"],
  tidy_m7$conf.low[tidy_m7$term == "year_c:faJP-led"],
  tidy_m7$conf.high[tidy_m7$term == "year_c:faJP-led"],
  tidy_m7$p.value[tidy_m7$term == "year_c:faJP-led"],
  "Gap widening 1.2% per year",
  
  "H3d: Balanced dominance convergence", "year_c:dominanceBalanced",
  tidy_m7$estimate[tidy_m7$term == "year_c:dominanceBalanced"],
  tidy_m7$conf.low[tidy_m7$term == "year_c:dominanceBalanced"],
  tidy_m7$conf.high[tidy_m7$term == "year_c:dominanceBalanced"],
  tidy_m7$p.value[tidy_m7$term == "year_c:dominanceBalanced"],
  "Balanced advantage growing 6.4% per year"
)

print(hypothesis_tests)
```

```{r}
library(gt)

table6 <- hypothesis_tests %>%
  mutate(
    IRR_formatted = sprintf("%.3f", IRR),
    CI_formatted = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", CI_lower, CI_upper),
    p_formatted = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001***",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ sprintf("%.3f**", p_value),
      p_value < 0.05 ~ sprintf("%.3f*", p_value),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_value)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Hypothesis, IRR_formatted, CI_formatted, p_formatted, Interpretation) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Table 6: Key Hypothesis Tests - Leadership and Citation Impact"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Hypothesis = "Hypothesis",
    IRR_formatted = "IRR",
    CI_formatted = "95% CI",
    p_formatted = "p-value",
    Interpretation = "Finding"
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Reference categories: VN-led first authorship, VN-dominated authorship, Vietnam correspondence. IRR > 1 indicates more citations. Year centered at 2019 (mean).",
    locations = cells_title()
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "*** p < 0.001; ** p < 0.01; * p < 0.05",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = p_formatted)
  )

print(table6)

table7 <- subsample_comparison %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~sprintf("%.3f", .))) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Table 7: Robustness Checks - Key Coefficients Across Subsamples (IRR)"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Coefficient = "Variable",
    Full = md("**Full**<br>(N=8,834)"),
    Funded = md("**Funded**<br>(N=5,130)"),
    Q1Q2 = md("**Q1/Q2**<br>(N=7,533)"),
    Bilateral = md("**Bilateral**<br>(N=4,746)"),
    Multilateral = md("**Multilateral**<br>(N=4,088)"),
    Recent = md("**Recent**<br>(N=7,151)")
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "All models control for year, collaboration type, funding, quality, and fields. IRR = Incidence Rate Ratio (exponentiated coefficients).",
    locations = cells_title()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Full)
  )

print(table7)
```

```{r}
#| label: viz-macro-evolution
#| fig-cap: "Evolution of Macro Disciplines in Japan-Vietnam Collaboration (2000-2025)"

# 1. Data Transformation
macro_trend <- dat_reg |>
    filter(year > 2000) |> 
  dplyr::select(year, LS, SS, PS, HS) |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) |>
  # Convert to long format to separate multiple classifications per paper
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(LS, SS, PS, HS), 
    names_to = "Macro_Area", 
    values_to = "presence"
  ) |>
  # Filter to keep only active classifications
  filter(presence == 1) |>
  # Count occurrences per year and area
  count(year, Macro_Area) |>
  # Re-label for cleaner legend names
  mutate(Macro_Area = dplyr::recode(Macro_Area,
    "LS" = "Life Sciences",
    "SS" = "Social Sciences",
    "PS" = "Physical Sciences",
    "HS" = "Health Sciences"
  ))

# 2. Plotting
ggplot(macro_trend, aes(x = year, y = n, fill = Macro_Area)) +
  # geom_area defaults to position = "stack", showing absolute volume
  geom_area(alpha = 0.85, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Macro Discipline") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2025, 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Classifications"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "gray30")
  )
```
